Customer opens /loans or the recommendations carousel
GET /api/v1/loans/offers, GET /api/v1/recommendations

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Figures from the customer's own ledger:
monthly income from recurring credits, monthly spending,
existing and active PBIP loan EMIs,
available balance of all accounts

span.p:
Rule 1: no sign-in lockout
in the last 90 days?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Largest new EMI rules 3 to 5 allow:
3. repayments at most 50% of income
4. spending, PBIP EMIs and the new EMI at most 90% of income
5. available balance covers at least one new EMI
